title: Hackly
summary: HACK'LY, adjective [from hack.] Rough; broken as if hacked. In mineralogy, having fine, short, and sharp points on the surface; as a hackly fracture.

inlines.v: HACK'LY, adjective [from hack.] Rough; broken as if hacked. In mineralogy, having fine, short, and sharp points on the surface; as a hackly fracture.
